problem: Let $A$ be a $5\times 7$ matrix. If $B={{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3},{b}_{4}}$ is a basis of $\text{Col}(A)$, find $\text{dim(Null}(A)).$

examples.knowledge_point: Finding the Rank or Nullity of a Matrix Given a Description of the Column or Null Space
examples.problem: Let $A$ be a $3\times 5$ matrix. If $\mathcal{B}= \{\mathbf{b_1}, \mathbf{b_2}, \mathbf{b_3}\}$ is a basis of $\textrm{Col}(A)$, find $\textrm{dim(Null}(A)).$
examples.worked_solution:
According to the rank-nullity theorem, if $A$ is a matrix with $n$ columns, then 

$$
\textrm{rank}(A) + \textrm{nullity}(A) = n.
$$

For the given matrix, we have $n=5,$ and since $\mathcal{B}$ is formed by $3$ vectors, $\textrm{rank}(A) = 3.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{rank}(A)+\text{nullity}(A) & =n \\ 3+\text{nullity}(A) & =5 \\ \text{nullity}(A) & =5-3 \\ \text{dim(Null}(A)) & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
